subject.title: [Bug]: tools/sandbox: MEDIA_MAX_BYTES (5 MB) is hardcoded and not user-configurable

question: What store and sandbox-staging media size-limit contract should OpenClaw support, including the default, hard maximum, and precedence with existing mediaMaxMb settings?
rationale: The source issue is clear, but choosing a configurable cap changes sandbox and resource boundaries and cannot be safely inferred from existing partial media settings.

options.title: Define a bounded shared cap
options.body: Add a documented and validated store/staging limit with secure defaults and a hard maximum, then wire all affected media paths to the same resolved value.

options.title: Land only the Telegram slice
options.body: Review the focused Telegram outbound PR for immediate document-delivery relief while keeping this issue open for the broader store and sandbox-staging contract.

options.title: Keep the fixed core cap
options.body: Reject configurability and accept continued failures for larger sandboxed media unless a separate per-path exception is explicitly approved.

recommendation.title: Define a bounded shared cap
recommendation.body: Add a documented and validated store/staging limit with secure defaults and a hard maximum, then wire all affected media paths to the same resolved value.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses the sandbox/media security boundary where steipete has the strongest feature-history signal.
